text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the first crown of the Tiara route,
the Oka Sho—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"You only get one chance in a lifetime to challenge
the Triple Tiara. I hear many get even more
nervous than they did for their debut..."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Biceps pump: optimal.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
As for your pectorals...
let's stimulate them a little more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna calmly checks the condition of her muscles.
Even on the brink of a major race, she remains unshakeable.
choice_data_list: (If anything, I might be more nervous than she is...)
(If anything, I might be more nervous than she is...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, I felt the pressure.
Gentildonna's ability is the real deal.
If she doesn't win... it's on me."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: If you have confidence as a Trainer, then hold your head high and wait for victory.
choice_data_list: (I bet it's obvious how nervous I am)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, telling her that outright would be meaningless.
What I need to show her right now...
is confidence, standing beside her as an equal.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Huh.
What do you want?
choice_data_list: Words to be bestowed upon future Tiara Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Chuckle.
My, what extraordinary bravado.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Very well. In that case... I shall ask once you return.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I'll be looking forward to your finest compliments...
fit for a winner.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Ms. Gentile.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Verxina-san.
Good day.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "At long last... we meet on the grand stage of a GⅠ."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Ah, I see... How strange.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Even though I've seen that crushed look on your face
so many times before.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Until now. In training, in mock races... I kept losing to you.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: “However, even that ends today. I will bring it to an end at this very moment.”

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
In a race where there are no second chances,
I shall etch your defeat into you!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Chuckle.
My, how straightforward.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Someone else will surely be
the center of attention today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna must be talking about
the girl who was named last year's
Best Junior Class Queen Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As the Classic campaign begins in earnest,
the lineup of rivals grows even deeper and tougher.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, that means in her eyes,
I'm number one... doesn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I etched it
a little too deeply.
choice_data_list: We gotta watch out for Verxina
We'd better watch out for Verxina, huh

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
No.
Every single one of them.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I will keep a close eye on everyone
and factor them into my calculations.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"That is the stance the strong ought to take.
Though it's likely different for challengers."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Now then, first up is... number one.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Even the faint glow of cherry blossom pink—
I shall wear it with grace."
